title: cirrus.yaml
description: Salesforce development automation: the orgs a project creates, the commands it runs, and the flows that sequence them.

orgs.description: The scratch orgs this project creates, keyed by the name you refer to them by.

commands.description: The commands this project runs, keyed by the name `cirrus run` takes.

flows.description: Sequences of steps, run in order, stopping at the first step that fails.

definitionFile.description: Path to the scratch org definition file, relative to the project root.

duration.description: How many days the scratch org lives. Salesforce's own default applies when this is absent.

alias.description: The alias the org is created under. Defaults to the name this org is keyed by.

default.description: Create this org when `cirrus run create_scratch` is given no --name. At most one org may say so.

namespace.description: Whether the org carries the project's package namespace. Set false for an org standing in for a subscriber's, which does not.

wait.description: Minutes to wait for the org to be created. Salesforce's own default applies without it.

command.description: The command line to run, or a mapping carrying it. Commands are not run through a shell: `&&`, pipes and $VARIABLES are arguments rather than syntax.

run.description: The command line to run. A command with only `dependsOn` is a name for its prerequisites, and runs nothing itself.

description.description: What this command is for, shown in `cirrus run --help`.

dependsOn.description: Commands that must have run before this one. A prerequisite, not a step: it runs once however many times it is named, and siblings run in the order written.

description.description: What this flow is for, shown in `cirrus flow --help`.

dependsOn.description: Commands that must have run before the flow's first step, once each.

step.description: A step names its kind with its first key.

createScratch.description: The name of an org defined under `orgs`.

setDefault.description: Set the created org as the CLI's default. True when absent.

command.description: The name of a command defined under `commands`.
